ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with high-intensity (white/grey) regions accounting for approximately 25% of the total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottled patches are located on the distal margins of both lobes, containing numerous circular black voids. The central region around the notch is solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with an approximate vertex angle of 40 degrees and a deep vertical displacement.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys, with greater amplitude on the outer lobe sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the distal edges of both lobes, sweeping inward toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular ring-like marks (circular voids/outlines) across both lobes, particularly visible as black rings within the white pigmented distal regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical linear scratches are visible within the white pigmented patch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy accumulation of calcified barnacle clusters at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, causing physical surface protrusion.
